author: Chris D. Johnson
title: Elk Grove double homicide suspect extradited from Texas, booked into jail - NewsBreak
text:
By Chris D. Johnson ,
8 hours ago
(FOX40.COM) — A man who fled from California after an alleged double homicide at a local Elk Grove bar was extradited back from Texas on Tuesday.
The Elk Grove Police Department announced Wednesday that 43-year-old Roderick Randall had been successfully transported back to Sacramento and booked into the Sacramento County Main Jail.
Roderick Randall, 43 Randall is the suspect of the November 2025 shooting at Z Town Gastro Pub that caused the death of two people and the injury of multiple others. Officials say Randall was identified as the suspect after an investigation, and police obtained an arrest warrant charging him with two counts of homicide, assault with a deadly weapon and possession of a firearm by a prohibited person.
In January 2026, Randall was taken into federal custody in Texas for allegedly providing false information to federal law enforcement officers. According to officials, detectives have been working with federal authorities and the Sacramento County District Attorney’s Office on his return to California since then.
Officials said Elk Grove PD detectives met the extradition team at the Sacramento International Airport and took custody of Randall before booking him into jail. The investigation will continue. and Randall will now faces charges in Sacramento County.
